span.p:
KNOWN LIMITATION
The prepared ledger carries no timestamp. It reads
identically 10 seconds and 10 days later.

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
KNOWN LIMITATION
sessionStorage is per-tab. Opening Order Drafts in a NEW
tab shows the empty state. The drafts are not lost, they
belong to the other tab's session.

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
NOTE back inside the drafts view is a no-op by design.
It is a destination, not a step in the flow.
